result.title: View Management with Gaussian Placement and Opacity Regularization for Online 3DGS
result.summary: The realistic rendering of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has drawn interest from real-time applications that require maps to be built online. This led to coupling 3DGS with SLAM, providing camera poses and initial Gaussians for the map. However, the map is still optimized with designs inherited from conventional SLAM, which train only on keyframes selected for localization and regularize geometry with uncertain frontend depth. These designs overlook the model complexity of a 3DGS map: with millions of parameters but few views of each region, the map overfits to sparse inputs. Resolving this is challenging, as every view and Gaussian added to the map competes for the same real-time budget. We close this gap from both sides. To add views while keyframes preserve the structure of the map, we progressively admit non-keyframe images as mapping updates complete and allocate the limited updates across different groups of frames according to the supervision each group provides. To control the model complexity of the map, edge-guided initialization places new Gaussians where image detail requires them. To complement the uncertain frontend depth, Self-Referenced Opacity Regularization (SOR) uses accumulated rendering evidence, at no extra rendering cost, to suppress the opacity of Gaussians that persistently contribute in front of a map-derived surface reference. Together, these designs improve both the appearance and the geometry of online maps within the real-time budget.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究在线 3D Gaussian Splatting 建图中的视角管理问题，通过渐进引入非关键帧图像、按监督量分配更新、边缘引导的 Gaussian 初始化以及自参照不透明度正则化，缓解地图对稀疏输入的过拟合。
AI.relevance_reason: 内容属于 3DGS-SLAM 的渲染与几何优化，不涉及多模态或视觉推理中的内部视觉状态、潜在推理与证据使用，也没有可供核查的 LVR 方法线索。
